propositions: Plan review must independently classify each acceptance-criterion checkbox as either codebase-verifiable or operator-attested based on where its completion evidence can truthfully be verified, not via keyword-only detection.
Criteria carrying the exact case-insensitive [operator-attested] tag must have evidence that inherently lives outside the repository; untagged or malformed tags default to codebase-verifiable.

Externally verifiable criteria without the exact tag or with malformed tags must produce findings that name the correct [operator-attested] syntax; codebase-verifiable criteria incorrectly tagged [operator-attested] must produce findings explaining that ticket comments cannot substitute for repository proof.

Mixed-evidence criteria that bundle both repository proof and outside-world proof must be flagged for splitting into independently certifiable criteria rather than silently assigned one evidence kind.
High-confidence evidence-kind misclassification findings must participate in normal validity × impact blocking policy, while deterministic keyword detection remains advisory and records abstentions.
